implementation_summary: Exported updateEditsOverlay(store, auditId, version, mutate) running read, mutate, save and edited flag on the per-version save queue; PATCH now uses it. Added a concurrency regression test.
risks: The queue is in-process, so it covers a single runner instance only.
The new test relies on timing (250 ms delay in the slow mutate). If PATCH reached the queue after the mutate finished, the test would pass without proving the race.
handoff: In packages/runner/src/routes/index.ts (about lines 199-206), replace the direct read, change and write of edits.json in the rewrite-accept path with: `import { updateEditsOverlay } from './audit-documents.js'` and `await updateEditsOverlay(store, auditId, version, (current) => <return current with the accepted rewrite applied, as an EditOverlay>)`. The function writes the overlay and sets edited:true itself, so remove the separate store.writeVersionJson(..., 'edits', ...) and store.updateVersion(..., { edited: true }) calls. It returns the saved EditOverlay.
